summary: New sense 2: eine Bedingung stellen, etwas zur Bedingung machen

data.gloss: eine Bedingung stellen, etwas zur Bedingung machen

rationale: Marriage is explicitly conditional, without a reciprocal contest, opponent or stake. One attestation distinguishes stipulation from wagering.

data.turoyo: Omər: "Aṯili ḏ̣ayfe, hənne mərre: "Ḥḏo šakṯo kətle lu qoḏ̣e." Omanno: "Tarte ne. Mšaraṭlan."
data.translation: "Ach", antwortete der Fuchs, "es sind Graste zu mir gekommen, die haben behauptet, du habest nur eine Hode; ich aber sagte, du habest deren zwei; da haben wir miteinander gewettet."

rationale: Thin Preterit cell: first-person plural and content supplied by preceding opposing claims.

data.turoyo: Hawo ste mšaraṭle u šruṭano aʕme: "Ənkan d qəṭʕina bas sayfe ḥḏoḏe, lazəm dowət farəs w malfono kayiso, d moḥət ʕal i iḏo čappiye aw d moḥət ʕal i iḏo raṣṭiye.
data.translation: Auch mit diesem machte er die gleiche Bedingung aus: "Wenn wir mit den Schwertern dreinschlagen, so mußt du ein rechter Ritter und guter Meister sein, und den Streich auf die linke oder die rechte Hand führen.

rationale: Fifth Preterit sense 1 example: cognate terms noun, ʕam-partner and explicit condition.

data.turoyo: L ḥa məlle: "Kito noše dlo kullat." L ḥa məlle: "Ašər layt." Xabro mawo, ḥa mawo, komər mšaraṭṭe.
data.translation: Der eine sprach: Es gibt Menschen, die keinen Kummer haben, der andere sprach: Es gibt keine. Ein Wort ergab das andere, sie gingen eine Wette ein.

rationale: Unusual assimilated plural mšaraṭṭe, contrasting inherited mšaraṭlan and singular forms.

data.turoyo: Əmmo: "Ono mšaraṭli, ono towewa žboni d babux, lo saymowayno babux.
data.translation: Dann sprach sie: "Ich habe nur unter einer Bedingung geheiratet. Deinen Vater hätte ich um seinetwillen nicht genommen.

rationale: New stipulation sense 2; concise marriage condition statement in full.

summary: II wagering has plural/reciprocal participants, ʕam- partner and ʕal- stake. Cognate šruṭ may express the terms; no Detransitive is licensed by reciprocity.

Ten supplied assurance tokens in one MAC interview recur before and after propositions, with no partner or stake. Discourse function is clear; the connection to mšaraṭ and their proposed Imperativ person are not. They are rejected as glossary analyses and retained in questions rather than treated as ten independent new senses.
Added conditional stipulation as sense 2, from one marriage statement; keep existing betting sense 1 and its broad conditions within actual wagers.

Coverage is three Preterit and four Infectum examples initially, including personal-communication items. Added two distinct Preterit contexts toward five and one assimilated plural form for its morphology; Infectum proposals do not supply a missing form.
No Idiomatic phrases added: no securely assigned new collocation; an unidentified assurance particle cannot be given an invented verbal headword.

Identify Mašraṭ/mašraṭ in MAC NE Interview 2 (/118, /126, /130, /138, /172, /174, /239, /241). Is it historically/synchronically related to šrṭ 'wager', a formula of another root, or an independent particle? Native/edition evidence is required before assigning an Imperativ.
69/92: confirm how marriage condition content continues beyond the supplied verse; one clear stipulated-condition statement supports the proposed sense, without adding unstated terms.
The readers describe only two Preterit examples in some comments; the supplied entry actually contains three. Preserve personal-communication examples in counts.
